shot.name: ocean-voyage
shot.prompt: Photoreal cinematic miniature world, tactile ivory origami paper boat with one crisp triangular sail and sharply folded hull, no writing on the paper. Warm amber practical light against deep petrol-blue shadows, natural film contrast, 35mm commercial cinematography. The same single small ivory paper boat is the only hero object. Wide low cinematic view of a tiny ivory origami sailboat sailing across a vast deep blue ocean at twilight. The folded paper hull remains rigid and intact. Long gentle waves dwarf the little boat; amber light glows on the distant horizon. The camera travels steadily beside the boat close to the water. Beautiful scale contrast, believable moving water. One uninterrupted five-second shot.
shot.sourceBrief: Create a memorable AutoPromote welcome film and social campaign from an idea alone, with no recorded footage. Show imagination becoming finished work, rather than a feature list.
